verdict.rationale: Basecamp publishes a REST API reference and OpenAPI spec covering every endpoint, with "Copy as cURL" examples throughout that can be run directly. The reference is static documentation on GitHub, though; nothing shows an interactive explorer or in-browser try-it console. missing for 10: interactive API explorer/try-it-out console, in-browser runnable execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The OpenAPI spec and this REST API reference cover authentication, pagination, and every endpoint in detail.
Throughout the Basecamp API docs, we include "Copy as cURL" examples.
